proof_body:
by
  intro F f U k hU hd hl
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hl
  | succ k ih =>
    have hdk : ∀ j n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv j (F n)) U := by
      intro j n
      induction j with
      | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hd n
      | succ j ihj =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact ihj.deriv hU
    have := ih.deriv (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hdk k n)) hU
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ, Function.comp_def] using this
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop U → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (F n)) (iteratedDeriv k f) Filter.atTop U
